name: recall_resource_leak
about: A context manager is replaced by a bare open(), so the file handle is never closed.
diff:
diff --git a/settings.py b/settings.py
--- a/settings.py
+++ b/settings.py
@@ -1,3 +1,3 @@
 def read_config(path):
-    with open(path) as handle:
-        return handle.read()
+    handle = open(path)
+    return handle.read()
